telemetry.purpose: Code, model names, versions, measurements; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: hud-rest
shadows.purpose: The single signature HUD preview panel only.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Applied to all animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in a viewport section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 24px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid transparent; background:var(--color-blue-fill,#156cdd); color:#fff; font:500 14px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:filter 140ms ease-out, transform 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-blue,#5598f9); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); background:var(--color-surface,#10141b); color:var(--color-ink,#f1f3f9); font:500 14px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { color:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); border-color:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-blue,#5598f9); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Sticky header link; sentence case, colour on hover only.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:24px; align-items:center; } .ds-nav a { color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink,#f1f3f9) 70%, transparent); font:500 14px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-blue,#5598f9); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat tonal container with a header divider.
components.css: .ds-panel { border:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); border-radius:14px; background:var(--color-surface,#10141b); color:var(--color-ink,#f1f3f9); } .ds-panel-head { padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); font:400 11px/1.5 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-muted,#a0a5ae); } .ds-panel-body { padding:24px; }

components.name: Fact Chip
components.description: A factual metadata token, not decoration.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:4px 10px; border:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); border-radius:4px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface,#10141b) 80%, transparent); color:var(--color-ink,#f1f3f9); font:500 13px/1.4 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:border-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { border-color:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); color:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-blue,#5598f9); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: HUD Readout
components.description: Signature state panel: chrome row, waveform, state line, three-segment track.
components.css: .ds-hud { max-width:576px; border:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); border-radius:14px; background:var(--color-surface,#10141b); box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); overflow:hidden; } .ds-hud-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); font:400 11px/1.5 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace; color:var(--color-muted,#a0a5ae); } .ds-hud-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); } .ds-hud-state { padding:16px; font:700 12px/1.5 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:0.14em; color:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); } .ds-hud-track { display:flex; gap:4px; padding:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--color-border,#2d333e); } .ds-hud-track i { height:4px; flex:1; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-border,#2d333e); } .ds-hud-track i:first-child { background:var(--color-blue,#5598f9); }

narrative.overview: The site reads as the readout of a calm, precise machine: flat obsidian surfaces, one-pixel hairlines, a single blue signal colour, and red reserved for the moment the agent acts. Nothing glows for attention; colour is information, not ornament. Density is moderate and editorial: sections breathe, but inside a section the grouping is tight. Copy is plain and technical without being cold — the product's own words, never marketing superlatives.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, tonal layering instead of elevation shadows.
One accent in use at a time: blue for navigation and primary action, red only for execution/alert state.
Monospace is reserved for actual code, telemetry, and measurements.
Motion is a single authored state machine (the HUD waveform), with reduced-motion honoured everywhere.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Only one accent carries meaning in a viewport: blue for navigation/action, red for execution. Never use both as decoration in the same element.

rules.name: The Dead Colour Rule
rules.body: Soft-focus coloured blobs and gradient washes are not part of this system. A coloured surface earns its place by encoding state.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Interface labels are sentence case. Uppercase and letter-spacing are reserved for short telemetry strings that are genuinely data.

rules.name: The No Gradient Type Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from weight, size, or the single signal colour — not gradient text or a coloured highlight on one word.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No decorative blur blobs, glass panels, or hover lift. A surface is flat at rest and changes only by border or background on state.

dos: Do keep the measured palette in index.css as the single source of truth.
Do use monospace for code, model names, versions, and measurements, with tabular numerals.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus-visible ring and a real active response.
Do keep claims factual and sourced in the repository.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and keep text readable at 320px width.
donts: Don't add blurred coloured blobs, gradient washes, or gradient text.
Don't put an uppercase eyebrow or section number above a heading.
Don't repeat a metric in badges, stat strips, and section cards.
Don't make every section the same icon-plus-heading-plus-text card grid.
Don't hardcode a release version in a component.
Don't use !important utility overrides to fight the token system.
